title: Supplementary materials for: Urban planning leaves an audible legacy in a megacity’s bird soundscape
description: Accompanying SA materials, R and Stan code, de-identified model-ready inputs and selected retained draws for Urban planning leaves an audible legacy in a megacity’s bird soundscape. Precise coordinates, identity keys, raw recordings and source rasters are not distributed. Scoped licences are documented in the repository.
notes: Scoped licensing: software is BSD-3-Clause; project-owned data/materials are CC BY 4.0; OSM-derived input components retain ODbL 1.0 terms. Raw third-party assets are not distributed. See LICENSE, data/LICENSE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
